title: Different file dialog functions work differently on Android but they should do the same thing
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in : v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]

### System information

Android 16

### Issue description

I was trying to have the user select a folder on android.

After a bit of troubleshooting, I found that these 3 methods, that look like they should do the same thing, actually don't.

```
extends Node

@export var file_dialog : FileDialog # UseNativeDialog == true

func _ready() -> void:
	# Don't use all three methods at once, comment at least two to see wich one works
	
	##### Method 1 #####
	# PC -> Opens native dialog (GOOD)
	# Android -> Opens non-native dialog (the one you see in the editor if you place a FileDialog in a scene) (should be the native one, BAD)
	
	file_dialog.show()
	
	##### Method 2 #####
	# PC -> Opens native dialog (GOOD)
	# Android -> Does nothing (BAD)
	
	var fd : FileDialog = FileDialog.new()
	fd.use_native_dialog = true
	fd.show()
	
	##### Method 3 #####
	# PC -> Opens native dialog (GOOD) (although it's a slightly different one for some reason)
	# Android -> Opens native dialog (GOOD)
	
	DisplayServer.file_dialog_show("", "", "", true, DisplayServer.FileDialogMode.FILE_DIALOG_MODE_OPEN_FILE, [], _callback)

func _callback(status: bool, selected_paths: PackedStringArray, selected_filter_index: int):
	print("ඞ")

```

I think that at least the method 1 should work. (I've heard that method 2 doesn't work because the file dialog isn't part of the scene tree, but it shouldn't need to be in the scene tree since it's native, and it works on pc).

### Steps to reproduce

- Download the MRP, or copy-paste the script above and set the file_dialog reference.

- Try each method by commenting out the other 2, and exporting the project for android.

- Test on android each method
